evidence.why: Shows all queue mutation and query paths, their interrupt boundaries and differing detached-node effects.
Diagnostic traversal performs no internal interrupt masking.

facts.rationale: Corrects the existing blanket interrupt-protection claim and distinguishes normal pop link clearing from targeted dequeue and wholesale sentinel reset.
facts.value: WaitingQueue lanes are initialized with both sentinel links self-referential; occupancy tests compare next against the sentinel. Tail insertion and head removal provide FIFO ordering within each lane. Push, check and targeted dequeue mask their shared-list accesses and restore saved interrupt state. Global pop restores that state between lane selection and the helper's independently masked unlink; the helper restores interrupts before nulling the removed block's links. Targeted dequeue leaves the removed block's own links intact. Clear, membership traversal and diagnostic dumping do not mask interrupts internally; clear resets only sentinel links and leaves abandoned command blocks untouched.
